Rashi on Berakhot 35b:11:1.hebrew: דרך טרקסמון - דרך שערי החצר והבית:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:11:1.english: Through the main gate - Through the gates of the courtyard and the house.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:11:2.hebrew: אין הטבל מתחייב במעשר - מן התורה, אבל אכילת קבע אסור לאכול מדרבנן:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:11:2.english: Untithed produce is not obligated in tithes - [This is] by Torah law, but it is rabbinically forbidden to eat a regular meal [from it].

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:11:3.english: The front of the house - The doorway of entry and exit.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:14:1.hebrew: זית אקרי - והוה ליה בורא פרי הפרי, שהפרי קרוי זית, ואין זו בריאת שמים, כי בידי אדם היא בריאה זו. אבל גבי גפן, הגפן היא העץ, והענבים הם פרי הגפן:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:14:1.english: [It] is called an olive - And it would be [as if reciting,] "Who creates the fruit of the fruit," for the fruit is called an olive, and this is not a creation of Heaven, for this creation is by human hands. But in the case of the vine, the vine is the tree, and the grapes are the fruit of the vine.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:15:1.hebrew: חמרא זיין - להכי חשיב לקבוע לו ברכה לעצמו:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:15:1.english: Wine nourishes - For this [reason], it is significant [enough] to establish for it a blessing of its own.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:17:1.hebrew: ואמר רב הונא - הא דקתני מותר במים ובמלח ואסור בשאר אוכלין ומשקין, לאו באומר קונם מזון עלי — דאין מזון אלא מה' מיני דגן: חטין ושעורין וכוסמין ושבולת שועל ושיפון — אלא באומר כל הזן עלי קונם. וכל מילי, נהי דלא אקרו מזון, מיהו מיזן זייני, בר ממים ומלח. אלמא, משחא זיין:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:17:1.english: And Rav Huna said - That which [the mishna] teaches, [that he is] permitted water and salt and forbidden all other foods and beverages, is not [in a case where] he says, "Nourishment is konam upon me" — for "nourishment" is only from the five species of grain: wheat, barley, spelt, oats, and rye — but rather [in a case where] he says, "Whatever nourishes is konam upon me." And all things, although they are not called "nourishment," nevertheless provide nourishment, except for water and salt. Hence, oil nourishes.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:18:1.english: Sustains - [It] is more significant than [mere] nourishment.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:19:1.hebrew: והכתיב ויין ישמח לבב אנוש - וסיפא דקרא: ״ולחם לבב אנוש יסעד״ — משמע: אבל יין אינו אלא משמח. ומשני: לאו כדקאמרת, אלא לחם יסעד ולא ישמח, אבל יין סועד ומשמח:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:19:1.english: And is it not written: “Wine gladdens the heart of man” - And the end of the verse, “and bread sustains the heart of man,” implies that wine, however, only gladdens. And [the Gemara] answers: [It is] not as you said; rather, bread sustains and does not gladden, but wine sustains and gladdens.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:1:1.hebrew: לאחר ברכה - הרי היא לבני אדם:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:1:1.english: After a blessing - Behold, it [the earth] belongs to mankind.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:20:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דזיין וסעיד, מזון הוא, ולבריך עליה שלש ברכות לאחריו. ואנן אמרינן לקמן בפרקין (ברכות דף לז.): כל שהוא משבעת המינין ולא מין דגן, חכמים אומרים ברכה אחת:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:20:1.english: If so - Since it nourishes and sustains, it is food, so let us recite three blessings after it. And [yet] we say later in our chapter (Berakhot 37a): "Whatever is of the seven species and is not a species of grain, the Sages say [one recites] one blessing."

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:1.hebrew: אוזוקי מזיק - לגופיה, ואין זו אכילה שטעונה ברכה, דגבי ברכה ואכלת כתיב:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:1.english: It causes damage - To his body, and this is not an [act of] eating that requires a blessing, for regarding a blessing, "And you shall eat" is written.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:2.english: As it was taught - For it is not fit for eating.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:3.english: One who drinks oil of teruma - [He did so] unintentionally.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:4.english: Pays the principal - As when one damages his fellow's property.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:5.hebrew: ואין משלם חומש - דגבי חומש, אכילה כתיב: ואיש כי יאכל קדש בשגגה (ויקרא כ״ב:י״ד) — פרט למזיק:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:22:5.english: And does not pay the fifth - For regarding the fifth, "eating" is written: "And if a man eats of the holy thing unwittingly" (Leviticus 22:14) — excluding one who causes damage.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:23:1.english: By means of bread - As a relish.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:23:2.hebrew: ע"י אניגרון - מין מאכל הוא, ונותנים לתוכו שמן. ושנוי במשנה בכמה מקומות:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:23:2.english: By means of anigeron - It is a type of food, and they put oil into it. And it is taught in the Mishna in several places.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:23:3.hebrew: דאמר רבה בר שמואל - לא אתא הכא, אלא לפרושי לן מאי ניהו:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:23:3.english: As Rabba bar Shmuel said - [This statement] was brought here only to explain to us what it is.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:23:4.english: Beet water - Water in which beets were boiled.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:2:1.english: Robs the Holy One, Blessed be He - [Of] His blessing.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:2:2.english: And the community of Israel - For when they sin, the produce is stricken.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:2:3.hebrew: אין פשע - ולפי שהוא מיקל, רואים האחרים ולמדין ממנו לעשות כן — ליהנות מן העולם בלא ברכה — ולכך נקרא זה המיקל חבר לאיש משחית:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:2:3.english: [It is] no transgression - And because he treats [it] lightly, others see and learn from him to do so — to derive benefit from the world without a blessing — and therefore this one who treats [it] lightly is called “a companion to a destroyer.”

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:3:1.hebrew: לירבעם בן נבט - שחטא והחטיא את ישראל, כך הוא חוטא ומחטיא:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:3:1.english: To Jeroboam ben Nevat - For [Jeroboam] sinned and caused Israel to sin; so [too], this one sins and causes [others] to sin.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:5:1.hebrew: בזמן שעושין רצונו - הדגן שלהם. וכשאין עושים רצונו, נוטלו ומראה להם שהוא שלו:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:5:1.english: At a time when they perform His will - The grain is theirs. And when they do not perform His will, He takes it and shows them that it is His.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:6:1.hebrew: דברים ככתבן - שלא יעסוק בדרך ארץ:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:6:1.english: The words [are] as they are written - That one should not engage in worldly occupation.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:6:2.english: Conduct with them - Along with words of Torah.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:6:3.hebrew: מנהג דרך ארץ - שאם תבא לידי צורך הבריות, סופך ליבטל מדברי תורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 35b:6:3.english: The custom of the way of the world - For if you come to need [the support of] other people, you will ultimately cease from [studying] words of Torah.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:7:1.english: Is it possible - [This is said] in astonishment: Is it possible [that it is] as you say?

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:9:1.english: During the days of Nisan - [These are] the days of the harvest.

Rashi on Berakhot 35b:9:2.english: In the days of Tishrei - The treading of the winepresses and the olive presses.

Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:11:1.hebrew: דרך טרקסמון - פירש"י: היינו דאורייתא, אבל מדרבנן גם חצר קובעת, כדמשמע בפ' יוצא דופן (נדה ד' מז:): "איזהו חצר שחייב במעשר" וכו', וכן מוכח בפ' המביא (ביצה ד' לה.):
Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:11:1.english: "By way of the main gate" [tirkesamon] - Rashi explained: This is [only] by Torah law; but rabbinically, a courtyard also establishes [the obligation for tithes], as is implied in chapter Yotzei Dofan (Niddah 47b): "What is a courtyard that is obligated in tithes?", etc., and as is likewise proven in chapter HaMevi (Beitzah 35a).

Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:18:1.hebrew: טובא גריר - מכאן משמע שאסור לשתות יין בערב פסח מן המנח' ולמעלה; ואם רוצה לשתו', צריך לשתות הרבה, דטובא מגריר גריר:
Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:18:1.english: A lot stimulates - From here it is implied that it is forbidden to drink wine on the eve of Passover from minḥah onward; and if one wishes to drink, he must drink a lot, for a lot [of wine] indeed stimulates [the appetite].

Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:1:1.hebrew: כאן לאחר ברכה - וכן בפ' כל כתבי (שבת ד' קיט.) אמרי': כשהיו מניחים השולחן, היו אומרים: "לה' הארץ ומלואה"; וכשהיו מסלקין השולחן, היו אומרים: "השמים שמים לה' והארץ נתן לבני אדם":
Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:1:1.english: Here [it is] after a blessing - And similarly, in chapter Kol Kitvei (Shabbat 119a), we say: When they would place the table, they would say, "The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof"; and when they would remove the table, they would say, "The heavens are the heavens of the Lord, but the earth He gave to mankind."

Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:5:1.hebrew: כאן בזמן שישראל עושין רצונו של מקום שנאמר ואספת דגנך - וא"ת: והא לקמן, בזמן שאין ישראל עושין רצונו של מקום מוקמי' ליה? וי"ל: דמיירי ודאי שעושין רצונו, אבל אין עושין רצונו כ"כ, דאינם צדיקים גמורים. ועוד י"ל: דפליג ליה אהא דלקמן, שבא לפרש מה בין עושים ואין עושין; והכא, בעושים ואין עושים כי הדדי נינהו:
Tosafot on Berakhot 35b:5:1.english: Here, at a time when Israel performs the will of the Omnipresent, as it is stated: "And you shall gather your grain" - And if you say: But surely later [in the Gemara], we establish it [as referring to] a time when Israel does not perform the will of the Omnipresent? And one can say: It is certainly dealing with [a case where] they perform His will, but they do not perform His will to that extent, for they are not completely righteous. And furthermore, one can say that he [Rabbi Ḥanina bar Pappa] disagrees with that [baraita] later, which comes to explain what [the difference is] between [when they] perform and [when they] do not perform [God's will]; whereas here, regarding [the cases of] performing and not performing, they are alike.
